claim: The demo command creates a populated sample report in a new temporary folder.
sandbox: Fresh Rust test process runs the installed project binary's demo command and checks its temporary output folder.

claim: A scan does not change supplied source, target, or catalog files.
sandbox: Fresh source, target, and SQLite catalog fixture; compare all input bytes after a scan writes named reports outside the inputs.

claim: The CLI writes JSON output for generic, Immich, darktable, and digiKam target profiles.
sandbox: Fresh source and target fixture; run JSON scans for all four documented profile values.

claim: The scanner inventories image file names without requiring valid image pixels.
sandbox: Fresh source and target fixture uses opaque invalid JPEG and WebP bytes; a completed JSON inventory proves no image decoder is required.

claim: The free CLI accepts samples up to 10 files; Pro accepts samples up to the 100-file hard limit.
sandbox: Fresh CLI fixtures run sample size 10 without a license, reject size 11 without a license, and accept size 100 with a recent recorded valid verdict.

claim: Try it with sample data opens a labelled report with populated migration findings.
test: npm run build:site && npx playwright test --grep "@claim:demo-populated-output"
sandbox: Fresh browser context follows the first-screen action and asserts the persistent demo label, controls, and realistic rows.

claim: The browser demo uses its own storage key, resets safely, and does not change real browser data.
test: npm run build:site && npx playwright test --grep "@claim:demo-isolated"
sandbox: Fresh browser context seeds a non-demo key, changes and resets the demo, then leaves demo mode.

claim: The browser demo does not upload files or contact third parties.
test: npm run build:site && npx playwright test --grep "@claim:demo-no-upload"
sandbox: Fresh browser context records every request during the full demo flow and permits only the product origin.

claim: Every published site page loads without analytics, advertising, remote fonts, or third-party runtime scripts.
test: npm run build:site && npx playwright test --grep "@claim:site-runtime-privacy"
sandbox: Fresh browser context visits home, demo, privacy, terms, and 404 while recording all requests; only GET requests to the product origin are allowed and no font request may occur.

claim: The sample report changes its target capability result for the selected profile.
test: npm run build:site && npx playwright test --grep "@claim:demo-profile"
sandbox: Fresh browser context selects darktable and checks the rendered report result and status text.

claim: A returned license is stored locally, verified with Sociobot, and removed from the URL.
test: npm run build:site && npx playwright test --grep "@claim:license-restore"
sandbox: Fresh browser context uses a recorded invalid verification response and asserts storage, status, and URL cleanup.

claim: A browser license token and verdict are stored locally; a valid verdict is reused for one day, and the token is sent only to Sociobot for verification.
test: npm run build:site && npx playwright test --grep "@claim:license-daily-verdict"
sandbox: Fresh browser context records every external request, uses a recorded valid Sociobot response, checks token and verdict storage, then proves a verdict just under one day is reused and an older verdict is refreshed only through the product verification endpoint.

claim: The Pro license is a $19 one-time purchase, and Buy Pro opens the registered Sociobot checkout with that offer.
test: npm run build:site && PLAYWRIGHT_TEST_BASE_URL=https://photo-edit-portability-map.sociobot.in npx playwright test --grep "@claim:checkout-starts"
sandbox: Fresh live browser context activates the real checkout link and checks the product name, $19.00 amount, and one-time description without entering payment details.

claim: The demo reloads offline after its first visit.
test: npm run build:site && PLAYWRIGHT_TEST_BASE_URL=https://photo-edit-portability-map.sociobot.in npx playwright test --grep "@claim:offline-demo-reload"
sandbox: New browser context visits the live demo over HTTPS, waits for its worker, goes offline, and reloads the populated sample.
